ITEM 1 | Sliced carrot rounds and coins, bright orange with slightly darker caramelized edges, glossy and moist, about 0.5-1 cm thick, covering the upper-left and lower-left of the plate in a loose cluster | 120
ITEM 2 | Cubed or wedged pale cream-colored starchy pieces with light golden-brown edges, firm and dry-looking, roughly 2-3 cm each, scattered among the carrots on the left side | 60
ITEM 3 | Fresh spinach-like leaves, dark green, flat and glossy, some whole and some torn, spread across the left and bottom of the plate and under the meat | 30
ITEM 4 | Sliced meat with rosy-pink to brown interior and browned outer surface, cut into thick diagonal slices about 1-1.5 cm thick, moist and fibrous, arranged in a fan on the right-center of the plate | 130
ITEM 5 | Green herb-and-oil dressing or pesto-like sauce with small flecks of chopped green herbs and pale minced bits, glossy and semi-wet, spooned over the meat slices | 15
ITEM 6 | Chopped pale toasted nut or seed pieces, small irregular bits about 2-3 mm, lightly golden, scattered over the meat and dressing on the right side | 5
ITEM 7 | Small orange carrot pieces, a few thin coin-shaped slices, sitting near the top-right edge of the meat | 8
